Malediction.text: Increases all periodic damage done by your Warlock spells by 1%.

Improved Bane of Agony.text: Increases the damage done by your Bane of Agony by 5%.

Fel Concentration.text: Gives you a 23% chance to avoid interruption caused by damage while channeling or casting your Drain Life, Drain Mana, Drain Soul, or Wrack spells.

Amplify Curse.text: Increases the effect of your next Curse of Weakness or Bane of Agony by 50%, or your next Curse of Exhaustion by 20%. Lasts 30 sec.

Malevolence.text: Increases the critical effect chance of your Shadow spells by 1%.

Siphon Life.text: Transfers 11 health from the target to the caster every 3 sec. Lasts 30 sec.

Soul Siphon.text: Increases the damage done or health drained by your Drain Life, Drain Soul, and Wrack spells by 4% per each of your other Affliction effects active on the target, up to a maximum increase of 12%.

Shadow Mastery.text: Increases the damage dealt or life drained by your Shadow spells by 1%.

Wrack.text: Tears the target apart from within, dealing 36 Shadow damage every 1 sec and increasing the damage they take from your other Shadow damage over time effects by 10%. Lasts 6 sec.

Improved Voidwalker.text: Increases the effectiveness of your Voidwalker's Torment, Consume Shadows, Sacrifice, and Suffering spells by 10%.

Fel Vitality.text: Increases the maximum health and Mana of your Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Incubus, and Felhunter by 5%, and increases your maximum Mana by 5%.

Demonic Energies.text: You heal your pet for 8% of all spell damage you deal. When you gain Mana from Life Tap, your summoned demon gains 50% of the Mana you gain.

Agonizing Flames.text: Increases the critical strike chance of your Searing Pain spell by 3% and the damage done by all your Destruction spells by 3%.

Conflagrate.text: Ignites a target that is already afflicted by your Immolate spell, dealing 88 to 110 Fire damage and consuming your Immolate effect.
